string-array.name: whatsnew_notes
string-array.item: Support Tawny is one new screen with the cat, the owlet and the dog: buy a coffee on Ko-fi, or tip in Bitcoin: pick $2, $5, $10 or your own amount and scan the code
When your tip arrives, the three of them celebrate and Tawny says thank you
The live screen works better with screen readers: connection changes are read out, and Who\'s here and the dimmed screen are proper buttons
